answer: Verified-work provides sybil resistance by requiring agents to perform 1,000 units of useful repair per identity; an honest agent pays this amount, while 1,000 fakes must solve 1,000,000 units. The verifier treats each task as a unique pearl of data, ensuring no delta in the labor occurs across the network. If a fault surfaces on the horizon of the graph, the proof is rejected and the effort is burned, preventing cheap entry.
